page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.13xlarge is a high-capacity storage-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The instance features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, delivering 52 dedicated vCPUs. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

A key feature of the ecs.i3.13xlarge profile is its substantial local storage capacity, offering 11,519 GB of integrated SSD storage directly attached to the host. Networking capabilities are supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The server operates without discrete GPU accelerators.

From a resource density perspective, combining a 52 vCPU count, substantial RAM, and over 11 TB of local SSD storage makes this instance suitable for I/O-intensive workloads. The direct-attached storage provides low-latency disk access compared to network-attached block storage, though reliance on local SSDs requires application-level data redundancy strategies to mitigate host failure risks.

Primary target workloads include high-throughput relational and NoSQL databases, large-scale data warehousing, real-time analytics, big data processing pipelines, and enterprise search platforms that require low-latency disk access and high memory capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.13xlarge is a storage-optimized cloud instance within the ecs.i3 instance family. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, it provides 52 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding roughly 7.38 GB of memory per core. The highlight of this hardware profile is its integrated local storage array consisting of 11,519 GB of fast SSD storage, combined with a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The high ratio of direct-attached storage to compute capacity eliminates network storage bottlenecks for disk-intensive operations. While local SSD storage provides high throughput and low latency, it introduces host dependency, necessitating software-defined replication for high availability. This instance is configured for large transactional databases, distributed file systems, real-time analytics engines, and data-intensive ETL workloads requiring high local storage performance.
